prompt: How many votes did the opposition party get in the Brant riding the election before Justin Trudeau was elected Prime Minister?
answer: In the 2011 federal election—the election before Justin Trudeau became prime minister—the New Democratic Party received **about 14,000 votes in the Brant riding**.
